algorithm: Python random.Random, sorted pools, six speakers/group, ten clips/speaker sampled without replacement

candidate_summary.interpretation: Explicit-mark rate is NOT completeness. Unmarked vowels can represent mid tone or missing annotation; no automatic restoration or correctness inference.
candidate_summary.nasal_proxy_limit: Spelling candidates only; n can mark nasalization or a consonant. Counts do not establish phonetic realization.

note: No duration-based selection before audio inspection. No tone restoration. Exclusions favor quieter reference material; other tags retained.
